periods.name: Rest of today
periods.text: South winds 15 to 20 knots. Rain with a slight chance of thunderstorms late this morning, then rain this afternoon. Waves 1 to 3 feet building to 2 to 4 feet.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: South winds 15 to 20 knots becoming southwest. A chance of rain in the evening. Waves 2 to 4 feet subsiding to 1 to 3 feet.

periods.name: Thursday

periods.name: Thursday night
periods.text: Southwest winds 10 to 15 knots becoming west. A chance of showers overnight. Waves 2 feet or less.

notes: Winds and waves higher in and near thunderstorms.
